title: Cobalt & Nickel Supply Chain: Surplus, Quotas & New Chemistries
gist: Member-only Benchmark Week 2026 video page for a keynote by Huayou Cobalt Senior EVP George Q. Fang (Nov 10, 2026). No transcript; the agenda says it covers how producers and buyers respond to Indonesian nickel supply, cobalt export quotas and the growth of LFP, and what that means for investment.

insights.claim: Huayou Cobalt's George Q. Fang presented at Benchmark Week 2026 on how producers and buyers are responding to three forces: Indonesian nickel supply, cobalt export quotas, and the growth of LFP.
insights.speaker: George Q. Fang, Senior Executive Vice President, Huayou Cobalt
insights.so_what: A major integrated cobalt-nickel producer names Indonesian supply, export quotas and LFP adoption as the main forces in its markets.
insights.quote: How producers and buyers are responding to Indonesian nickel supply, cobalt export quotas and the growth of LFP, and what that means for investment.
insights.locator: Keynote: The Evolving Cobalt & Nickel Supply Chain

insights.claim: The Huayou Cobalt keynote title pairs surplus with quotas, which presents the cobalt and nickel market as one where supply surplus and export quotas both shape conditions.
insights.speaker: George Q. Fang, Senior Executive Vice President, Huayou Cobalt
insights.so_what: Surplus conditions under quota-driven supply management create policy-driven price risk for cobalt and nickel investors.
insights.locator: Keynote: The Evolving Cobalt & Nickel Supply Chain

insights.claim: The growth of LFP chemistry is named by Huayou Cobalt as a factor in investment decisions across the cobalt and nickel supply chain. The video is member-only and the page gives no figures.
insights.speaker: George Q. Fang, Senior Executive Vice President, Huayou Cobalt
insights.so_what: A leading cobalt-nickel producer treats LFP growth as an investment-relevant force for its own supply chain, so chemistry shifts are a key watch item for nickel and cobalt demand.
insights.locator: Keynote: The Evolving Cobalt & Nickel Supply Chain

source_meta.author: George Q. Fang, Senior Executive Vice President, Huayou Cobalt
